code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation, low pO2), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, increased RDW and ferritin, and elevated INR. These findings suggest acute respiratory failure with possible underlying infection/inflammation and coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
